text:
alex: Quick sync — I want to land a "golden path" section in the Dedicated provisioning docs that shows the simplest flow for tenant onboarding + autoscale fallback microcopy. Goal: one short example + SDK snippet + SLA note. Who can own small PR?

maria: I can take the PR. Can you list the exact microcopy changes you want? keeping concise.

alex: Thanks. Draft microcopy:
- "Reserve capacity: create a Dedicated pool and attach tenant label."
- "Set scale policy: target RPS = 200, cooldown = 5m, fallback = 'regional-fallback'."
- "If capacity preempted, tenant will route to hosted fallback (best-effort) — see SLA note."

maria: OK. I'll add a "Golden path" subsection and a small callout box for fallback behavior.

oliver: SDK snippet (python) you can paste:
```python
client.create_scale_policy(
  tenant_id='acme',
  target_rps=200,
  cooldown_seconds=300,
  fallback_policy='regional-fallback'
)
```
I'll attach a minor change to show the API call and mention that fallback is async.

sre-jen: pls add an obs bullet: "How to validate fallback: simulate eviction with --force-evict and check requests routed to hosted-api in console.traces"

maria: Good call. Will add a troubleshooting mini-step.

docs-bot: PR #4321 opened by maria: docs/dedicated/golden-path.md — initial draft. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

alex: Awesome. One micro wording ask: replace "best-effort" with "best-effort, no SLA" — we shouldn't imply SLA.

maria: Done in PR, pushed commit. Also added a tiny YAML example for CLI:
```yaml
scale_policy:
  target_rps: 200
  cooldown: 300s
  fallback: regional-fallback
```

oliver: Quick nits: mention quantization-friendly models in the golden path note (for cost tip).

maria: Added cost/tuning tips. I'll merge after reviews green. tagging @product for visibility.

alex: Thanks everyone. After merge, can we add a short test job that runs docs smoke to ensure snippet renders? I'll open follow-up.

deploy-bot: docs smoke job started (build-789) — awaiting results.

alex: closing for now, will track the follow-up job. :thumbsup:
